about_the_game:
💰 Gamble, Survive, Repeat! 💰

Welcome to Bling Bling Bankruptcy, a high-stakes gambling adventure where every decision could be your last. Drowning in debt, you have only one way out—bet big, win bigger, and stay ahead of the collectors. But be careful… one bad day, and it’s game over!

🃏 Play Your Way to Fortune (or Ruin) 🃏

Test your luck and skills across a variety of classic and chaotic gambling games:

🎲 Poker – Outplay your opponents and go all-in.

🃏 Blackjack – Count cards or trust your gut.

🎡 Roulette – Red or black? Your fate spins in an instant.

🎯 Plinko – Drop and pray for the jackpot.

🐄 Bet Your Booze – Bet on the cow booze.. That's it.

🪙 Flip the Coin – 50/50, all or nothing.

💣 Mines – Avoid disaster and cash out before it’s too late.

📈 Stock Market – Buy low, sell high, or lose it all.

🛒 Upgrade Your Odds at the Local Store

Stop by the convenience store to buy items that boost your chances—lucky charms, energy drinks, or even shady insider tips. Every edge counts when your life is on the line.

📆 Can You Survive Another Day?

The clock is ticking. Each day, your debt grows. If you can’t pay up, it’s game over. Manage your time, take calculated risks, and climb your way out of financial hell—before the collectors find you.

🏆 How Far Can You Go?

• Rogue-like gambling mechanics: every run is different.

• Buy items to enhance your gambling skills and odds.

• A dark yet humorous take on the high-risk world of betting.

• Stylish pixel art aesthetic with a gritty casino vibe.

Are you ready to risk it all? Play Bling Bling Bankruptcy and roll the dice on your future! 🎰🔥
